title: Phase 9: Voxel Surface Exploration
abstract:
## Phase 9 — Voxel Surface Exploration

Disembarking the landed ship enters a fully explorable, destructible, Minecraft-style **voxel world** that reads as a seamless continuation of the same body — same palette, sky, fog and light, all derived from the shared Phase 8 `BiomeProfile`, with no rendering code shared between the two systems. Base `phase-9`.

### Sub-phases
- **9.0 — Mode skeleton.** `voxel` `SceneMode` + `disembark()`/`boardShip()`; scene routing hides the space scene on foot; Disembark button + `VoxelHUD`.
- **9.1 — Dynamic voxel core.** 32³ chunks in **bit-packed `Uint32Array`**, strict discriminated-union worker contract, **worker-pool greedy mesher** with baked AO + **vertex pooling** + **Transferable Objects**, CPU worldgen from the biome, quality-scaled streaming, and a live re-mesh edit path.
- **9.2 — AAA look.** TSL voxel material (baked AO, normal jitter, biome fog), camera-following sky dome mirroring the biome gradient/sun, and sun shadows.
- **9.3 — First-person movement.** AABB-vs-voxel collision with step-up, per-body gravity (Moon floaty) + friction (icy/dusty), mobile-first touch controls (joystick/look/jump) + desktop pointer-lock/WASD, visible hand/tool.
- **9.4 — Archetype biomes.** 6 archetypes mapped across all 16 bodies; emissive lava/glowing-ice (RGBA mesh channel); seas, dunes, impact craters, ice caverns + glow veins, lava lakes.
- **9.5 — Atmosphere + audio.** Per-body weather particles (Mars dust, Titan drizzle, Io ash, icy snow); per-material footsteps; underground cave drone; per-body ambient bed.
- **9.6 — Navigation & polish.** Compass with ship bearing + distance; reduced-motion-aware atmospheric transition wash; per-preset perf pass.

### Verification
- `npm run build` (`tsc && vite build`) clean; the mesher worker emits its own chunk; new files lint-clean (the 4 remaining eslint errors are pre-existing in untouched `descent/`/`ship/` files).
- **30 runtime logic tests pass** (run via esbuild bundle of the pure modules): 18 voxel (mesh integrity, greedy merge, worldgen, determinism, per-archetype signature blocks) + 12 player physics (rests on floor / no tunnelling, walls, step-up, jump, low-gravity apex ≈ 6× Earth).
- The repo has no browser test harness, so end-to-end visuals (look parity per body, glow/bloom, shadows, particle motion, audio, 60fps streaming + dig) are the documented **manual browser step**.

### Notes
- Voxel world is kept near the origin to avoid float precision loss far from the ship; "the ship" for navigation is the disembark point at the origin.
- Per-body **variation strategy** (atmosphere/lighting, noise params, instanced scatter, weather, gravity/friction) lets 16 bodies feel distinct from 6 archetypes. Instanced surface scatter (props) is the one planned layer not yet built — a natural follow-up.
